KEF QuickStay Apartments offers cosy and convenient accommodation in Keflavík, just minutes from Keflavík International Airport (KEF). Ideal for families, couples, groups and travelers with early flights or late arrivals, our apartment accommodates up to 6 guests. Enjoy comfortable beds, a fully equipped kitchen, washing machine and a fully independent entrance. Free public parking is available across the street, with easy access to shops and restaurants. A great choice for a relaxing stopover.
